digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center reconciler live verification suite
propositions: The epic's headline AC—an issue created in DC appears locally after inbound pass, and a local edit appears in DC after outbound pass—is now proven live against a real Data Center instance over a complete scrubbed copy of the production ticket store (2673 tickets), not an empty instance.

Five product defects were discovered and filed separately (d067 status-transition, 8d68 inbound-assignee mint, 751e outbound unassign, 2b16 inbound link removal, 88d9 inbound parent clear, 39c1 epic parent, 1a9f subask parent, 37e7 platform parent-clear refusal, 18a5 outbound create binding), each with live evidence, and the suite remains red on them intentionally until those fixes land.

Criterion 11 (all 28 mutations round-trip individually asserted) has 23 of 28 cells passing green; five cells are red on filed product/platform defects outside this story's scope, with one pending operator ruling on whether unfixed product bugs block story closure.

The store-copy mechanism is hardened with isolation in depth: primary (separate repo with no remotes, fresh git init), secondary (REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=off, no Cloud credential), tertiary (reconciler config points harness only), and verified (git remote returns nothing, test fails job if violated).

The scrub removes all .bridge_state* artifacts and is proven complete: zero binding or snapshot files survive under the copied tracker dir, verified by enumeration and structural filtering (not hardcoded lists), closing the inject-to-production vulnerability.
